-- public.vw_operaciones_recaudo source
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_operaciones_recaudo AS WITH cte_transaction_repayment AS ( SELECT ml.account_no AS identificador_cuenta, ccp."Cedula" AS numero_de_identificacion, mlt.submitted_on_date AS fecha_valor, mlt.principal_portion_derived AS monto_capital, mlt.interest_portion_derived AS monto_interes, mlt.fee_charges_portion_derived AS monto_cargos, 0 AS monto_impuestos, mlt.penalty_charges_portion_derived AS monto_penalidades, mlt.principal_portion_derived + mlt.interest_portion_derived + mlt.fee_charges_portion_derived + 0::numeric AS monto, mn.note AS notas, 'Pago Introducido'::text AS tipo, cc.name AS canal, ia.numero_identificacion_aliado FROM m_loan_transaction mlt LEFT JOIN r_enum_value rev ON rev.enum_name::text = 'loan_transaction_type_enum'::text AND mlt.transaction_type_enum = rev.enum_id LEFT JOIN m_loan ml ON mlt.loan_id = ml.id LEFT JOIN detalles_de_la_transaccion dt ON mlt.id = dt.loan_transaction_id LEFT JOIN detalles_transacciones_alianzas dta ON mlt.id = dta.loan_transaction_id JOIN m_client mc ON ml.client_id = mc.id JOIN campos_cliente_persona ccp ON mc.id = ccp.client_id LEFT JOIN m_code_value id_type_cv ON id_type_cv.id = ccp."Customer Identifier_cd_Tipo identificacion" LEFT JOIN m_note mn ON mlt.id = mn.loan_transaction_id LEFT JOIN m_payment_detail mpd ON mlt.payment_detail_id = mpd.id LEFT JOIN custom.c_channel cc ON mpd.channel_id = cc.id LEFT JOIN "Informacion Adicional" ia ON ml.id = ia.loan_id WHERE mlt.transaction_type_enum = ANY (ARRAY[2, 5]) ) SELECT identificador_cuenta, numero_de_identificacion, fecha_valor, monto_capital, monto_interes, monto_cargos, monto_impuestos, monto_penalidades, monto, notas, tipo, canal, numero_identificacion_aliado FROM cte_transaction_repayment;
